nonce: 12 fresh random bytes, encoded as standard Base64
ciphertext: Base64 of AES-GCM ciphertext followed by its 16-byte authentication tag
key: A 32-byte AES-256 key issued by the desk as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Keys are not derivable from capsule contents or submitted answers; the desk returns the key for each packet when the corresponding answer checks out.
associated_data: Canonical ASCII JSON of {"format":"XTRACT-V8","id":capsule_id,"algorithm":"AES-256-GCM"}, using sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true and no trailing newline
plaintext: ZIP of relative ordinary files. Opened files merge into the output directory; existing files are never overwritten.
decoder: open_capsule.py; Python 3 and cryptography are required
selftest: selftest/capsule.json opens with the key printed in selftest/key.txt. selftest/expected.json gives the decoded file digests.
note: XTRACT-V8 names the capsule envelope format, not a release version.
